description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Rehovot,ISR

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

We are looking for a highly talented engineer to join our Global Product Support (GPS) team.

Our team’s responsibilities include:

- Developing and maintaining expert‑level knowledge of our product line

- Leading complex and systematic escalations together with R&D

- Delivering knowledge and methodologies from PDC to Applied Materials customer engineers worldwide, ensuring improved tool health, performance, and stability

- Representing the voice of the field in all R&D discussions and activities

- Developing new procedures and Best Known Methods (BKMs) to support new products

- Creating and maintaining procedures for installation, calibration, troubleshooting and maintenance

-

What’s in it for you?

Become a key technical contributor in shaping next‑generation PDC technologies and make a significant impact on product stability, quality, and customer success.

Our Group

- Provides expert-level support for semiconductor metrology tools

- Works closely with R&D owners on assigned technical projects

- Acts as an intermediary between customers and development teams by providing technical support, documentation, and expertise to field engineers troubleshooting

What you'll be doing?

- Create and maintain hardware and service procedures for field use

- Participate in R&D development cycles and ensure all field aspects and serviceability requirements are incorporated

- Solve technical problems using established procedures, engineering judgment, and accumulated field experience

- Analyze information and apply best-known practices to make decisions and support escalations

What you should have?

- B. Sc. in Electrical /Mecanical other relevent technology field

- 0-2 years of experience

- Strong conceptual knowledge of engineering theories, practices, and procedures within your discipline

- Ability to apply general business understanding from prior experience or education

- Strong interpersonal skills: clear communication, asking questions, validating understanding

- A proactive, dedicated approach; team player; motivated to expand technical knowledge and drive data‑based decisions

- Ability to work within standardized procedures to meet deadlines and team objectives

Who we are?

Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control (PDC) business unit.

Located in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture, and market cutting‑edge machine‑learning and computer‑vision‑based metrology and inspection products essential for wafer fabrication. By enabling the production of next‑generation microchips, our technology helps customers turn innovation into reality.

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
New College Grad

Travel:
Yes, 25% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Job Description: Student Lab Assistant

We are looking for a highly motivated Student Lab Assistant to join our materials and contamination testing activities.

What’s in it for you?

- Hands-on laboratory experience in a high‑tech semiconductor environment.

- Exposure to cleanroom and wet chemistry labs.

- Opportunity to work closely with qualification teams and external labs.

What you’ll be doing:

- Perform experiments on materials for particulate contamination testing

- Wafer coating, preparation, and characterization

- Work in cleanrooms and wet chemistry laboratories

- Coordinate experiments with qualification teams and external labs

- Analyze data and prepare reports and summaries

- Support daily activities such as materials selection and purchase requests

What you should have:

- Student or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or Chemical Engineering

- At least 1.5 years remaining until graduation.

- Lab work experience – advantage

- Experience in data analysis and statistics – advantage

- Availability to work approximately 2–3 days per week

Who we are:

Applied Materials Israel is home to the Process Diagnostics and Control (PDC) business unit. Based in Rehovot, we develop, manufacture, and market cutting‑edge metrology and inspection solutions that enable the production of next‑generation microchips and support our customers worldwide.

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

What We're Looking For

Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

Electronics Manufacturing / NPI Engineer

Location:

Central Israel |

Industry:

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced

Electronics Manufacturing / NPI Engineer

to join Electronics Production Engineering team.

In this role, you will serve as the critical bridge between R&D, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing—taking complex electronic assemblies and PCBAs from development into smooth, high-reliability serial production.

What You Will Do:
NPI & DFM:

Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and support R&D during design phases with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and cost optimization.

Subcontractor (CM) Management:

Manage and provide technical support to Contract Manufacturers (PCBA/SMT and cable assembly vendors), resolving production issues on-site and remotely.

Production Documentation & Process Design: Define manufacturing flows, tooling/jigs, and inspection processes; author work instructions, technical specifications, BOMs, and production files (using CAD/CAM tools).

PRR & Floor Support:

Lead Production Readiness Reviews (PRR) with internal and external stakeholders, guide technicians during First Article (FAI) and serial runs, and troubleshoot assembly line issues.

Failure Analysis & Component Engineering: Lead root-cause failure investigations, maintain manufacturing knowledge, and support component engineering (finding alternate components / handling obsolescence).

Requirements:

B.Sc. in Electrical / Electronics Engineering

in Electronics Manufacturing Engineering / NPI (transitioning products from R&D to production) –

description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, designs and delivers high-end, custom silicon that sits at the very heart of AWS. Our devices don't just support the cloud — they actively define it. From Trainium, the purpose-built machine learning accelerator driving the next wave of AI innovation, to Graviton, the Arm-based server processor redefining price-performance for compute workloads, to Nitro, the advanced network and cloud management controller that powers every AWS instance — Annapurna's products consistently set the standard for the entire industry.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in developing the next generation of cloud products, in a highly collaborative, team-oriented environment.

We are hiring a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer to join the Signal Integrity and Packaging (SiP) group at Amazon's Annapurna Labs. This is a hands-on technical position for an experienced lab engineer who will lead characterization efforts for high-speed serial protocols in advanced semiconductor platforms.

You will design and execute comprehensive lab characterization campaigns, troubleshoot complex signal integrity issues, and drive data-driven optimization across PCIe, Ethernet, and other industry-standard serial interfaces. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong hardware debugging skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional design and validation teams.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead SerDes characterization campaigns for PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, and other serial protocols on advanced silicon and package platforms

- Design comprehensive test plans covering eye diagrams, bathtubs, jitter analysis and protocol compliance

- Operate and troubleshoot industry-standard lab equipment: oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and VNAs

- Analyze complex waveform and signal data; identify root causes of performance issues and signal integrity problems

- Collaborate with design teams to validate silicon behavior, debug hardware anomalies, and optimize link margins

- Develop characterization scripts and measurement techniques to improve efficiency and repeatability

- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to hardware design reviews from a characterization perspective

- Document findings and present technical results to stakeholders and leadership

A day in the life

As a Senior SerDes Characterization Engineer, you will own the lab characterization and validation of high-speed serial interfaces — from test plan definition and bench setup through silicon and board bring-up, link debug. You will work hands-on with oscilloscopes, VNAs and other test equipment.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including board design, packaging, ASIC, and firmware teams, to isolate link failures to their true source and drive them to closure. In addition, you will serve as the technical focal point for characterization on your projects — defining measurement methodology, making the judgement calls on what a marginal eye means, and setting the standard for how link margin is proven before silicon ships.

Basic qualifications
- 6+ years of hands-on lab characterization experience with SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, or equivalent high-speed serial interfaces)

- Deep understanding of signal integrity, jitter, eye diagrams, and link budget analysis

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in hardware bring-up and platform validation

- Experience with protocol compliance testing and standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, or similar)

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent field with substantial lab experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience characterizing multiple SerDes protocols (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe)

- Familiarity with high-speed package design, signal routing, and layout considerations

- Experience with automated measurement systems and scripting

- Background in silicon bring-up or hardware platform validation
